intent.raw: The ui-prototyping-studio spec feels shallow. Set up a dispatch with refine nodes and two dialectical zig-zag lanes (one for novel/better implementations + research of resonant-os-design-tokens philosophy and web tools, one to defend the current design), use residuality-spec for invalidations, domainspec UI types, the ux-evidence-validator basis, a planned-mode Playwright UI test lane, and a naive-user-who-does-not-know-the-app lane. Ergonomics is the first principle.
intent.objective: Deepen the ui-prototyping-studio feature spec to one-shot implementation readiness through a dialectical zig-zag exploration, hardened by residuality stressors, evidence-backed UX, a planned Playwright suite, and a cold-start naive-user walkthrough, with human-agent ergonomics as the first principle.
intent.operator_sentence: Explore max depth so we can implement this in depth; this is a test of our one-shot design and planning ability.

technique_overlays.trigger: Operator asked for two lanes that alternate generation and critique (zig-zag) while preserving a novel-implementation thesis against a defend-current-design antithesis until synthesis.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each contested point converges to a decision, a logged residue, or a deferred option; no endless alternation; synthesized design is expressed in domainspec UI types with an ergonomics-first rationale per kept decision.

technique_overlays.trigger: Ergonomics is the declared first principle; design claims must be backed by evidence, not asserted.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every non-trivial UX claim is classified (hard_gate/soft_flag/screenshot_review/human_study) and either backed by Playwright-observable evidence or named as a human-study residue; cold-start friction is captured from an uninformed agent.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Dialectical lanes, parallel external research, role-bound critique, and a context-isolated naive user all require sibling agents that cannot share each other's framing.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The route's value depends on independent perspectives. The challenger and defender must not collapse into one voice; the token/web researchers must fan out; and the naive-user agent must be denied the design rationale so its friction is genuine. These are role-bound sibling agents with isolated context, which the orchestrator (refine) must spawn and join under one dispatch_id.
context: Spec is architecture-strong and governance-clear but execution-light and evidence-sparse on human factors (per discovery): fitness scoring (O-004), exploit conformance metric, identity/DNA rejection lifecycle, accessibility interaction detail, and error/recovery flows are all underspecified.
Operator explicitly approved subagent spend for maximum-depth exploration in this conversation.
Naive-user evidence is only valid if the agent is isolated from internal docs and rationale.

roles.purpose: Research the resonant-os-design-tokens philosophy and whether/how it composes with domainspec Visual DNA types.
Survey current web tooling for UI prototyping studios, design-token pipelines, and evidence-backed UX so we know what to reuse vs build.
Generate novel/better implementation directions and alternative paths in domainspec UI types (antithesis).
Defend and deepen the current design and its load-bearing decisions D-001..D-009 (thesis), absorbing what it can and rejecting what it must.
Resolve the dialectic into one deepened design expressed in domainspec UI types.
Stress the deepened design to surface invalidations, attractors, and desired residue.
Translate ergonomics/accessibility/market practice into validator-safe checks and a fixture plan for the studio surfaces.
Devise the full planned-mode Playwright UI test suite (no execution) with expected evidence and failure interpretation per scenario.
Attempt the studio tasks cold, with only task goals and the rendered surface, to expose genuine ergonomic friction.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: This route spawns up to 9 role-bound subagents (2 researchers, challenger, defender, synthesis architect, residuality analyst, UX-evidence validator, Playwright planner, naive user). The naive-user agent is deliberately denied internal docs. Approve subagent execution under dispatch_id ui-prototyping-studio-deep-spec-001? (Operator approved in-session.)
receipt_requirements: for naive-user-agent: confirmation it received no internal rationale

steps.name: Build evidence baseline and ergonomics-first charter
stop_conditions: Context pack cites the existing spec, the domainspec UI type catalog, the ux-evidence-validator basis, and the ergonomics-first charter.

steps.name: Fan-out research: resonant-os-design-tokens philosophy + web tooling
stop_conditions: Each external source is labelled external_context with a citation.
Tooling survey names candidates to reuse vs build with trade-offs.

capability_metadata.note: deep-research harness; candidate for promotion to a canonical research capability

steps.name: Lane A (antithesis): novel and better implementations via refine
convergence_criteria: Produces at least 2 novel implementation directions expressed in domainspec UI types.
Each direction cites token/tooling research evidence or names a residue where evidence is missing.
Alternative paths are ranked by ergonomics gain versus implementation cost (pareto).
stop_conditions: At most 3 ranked directions; alternation halts once directions stop improving on ergonomics.

steps.name: Lane B (thesis): defend and deepen the current design via refine
convergence_criteria: Restates the load-bearing decisions D-001..D-009 with their rationale.
Names which Lane A proposals the current design can absorb versus must reject, with reasons.
Defends the manual-governance and evidence model on ergonomics grounds (governance as a feature, not friction).
stop_conditions: Defense responds to each Lane A direction exactly once; no re-litigation after synthesis opens.

steps.name: Zig-zag dialectic synthesis into one deepened design
convergence_criteria: Each contested point becomes a decision, a logged residue, or an explicitly deferred option.
Synthesized design is expressed entirely in domainspec UI types (entities, value objects, enums, states, operations).
An ergonomics-first rationale is stated for every kept or changed decision.
stop_conditions: Single converged design produced; residue ledger holds anything unresolved with an owner.

steps.name: Residuality: stress the deepened design for invalidations
stop_conditions: Every significant stressor maps to a desired residue or a named open question.
Attractors are reported as clusters with spec implications.

steps.name: UX evidence: validator-safe checks and fixture plan for the studio

inputs.ref: WCAG 2.2 + design-system UX practice + ergonomics-first charter

stop_conditions: Every non-trivial UX claim is classified hard_gate/soft_flag/screenshot_review/human_study with proxy limits named.
Hard gates only for deterministic or standards-backed failures.

steps.name: Planned-mode Playwright UI test suite (design only, no execution)
stop_conditions: Plan is planned-only; no tests are executed.
Each scenario names locator strategy, expected evidence (screenshot/trace/axe/measurement), and the failure interpretation if it breaks.

steps.name: Cold-start naive-user walkthrough (context-isolated agent)

inputs.ref: task-goal scenarios only (no internal docs, decisions, or rationale)

stop_conditions: Agent receives only task goals and the rendered surface.
Each blocker is captured as where a fresh user stalls, with the inferred missing affordance.

steps.name: Fold all evidence into a deepened spec proposal + one-shot implementation plan
convergence_criteria: Deepened spec proposal resolves the shallow areas (fitness scoring, exploit conformance, identity/DNA rejection, accessibility interaction detail, error/recovery).
One-shot implementation plan is layered and traceable to domainspec UI types and the test plan.
Residuality invalidations, UX evidence, and naive-user gaps are each addressed or carried as named residue.
stop_conditions: Proposal and plan are proposals only; no canonical spec file is mutated.

steps.name: Implementation-readiness decision and next-route menu
stop_conditions: Readiness verdict (ready|conditional|not-ready) recorded with the residue that blocks one-shot implementation, if any.

gates.condition: Ergonomics-first charter and dialectic role split are approved before lane execution.
External web/github research is labelled external_context and is not promoted to canonical memory.
Dialectic convergence_criteria for s2/s3/s4 are met, or unresolved points are logged as residue with an owner.
Every significant stressor maps to a residue or an open question (s5 evidence present).
UX claims are classified; hard gates are used only for deterministic or standards-backed failures.
Playwright plan is planned-only (no execution) and names expected evidence plus failure interpretation per scenario.
Naive-user agent received only task goals and the rendered surface, never internal rationale or decisions.
Dispatch does not promote SPEC/domain/glossary/inventory/ontology/sigil artifacts; the deepened spec stays a proposal pending operator approval.
DEEP-SPEC-PROPOSAL and ONE-SHOT-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN are approved before any spec mutation or implementation.

boundaries.contract: Web and GitHub sources are imported as labelled external_context and cited in evidence cards; never promoted to canonical inventory/ontology without owner review.
The naive-user agent receives only task goals and the rendered surface; it must not read design rationale, decisions, or internal docs.
The deepened spec is a proposal handoff; promotion to canonical SPEC requires human approval, mirroring the studio's own manual-governance ethos.

promotion_guardrails: Dispatch does not promote SPEC.md, domain.md, glossary, inventory, ontology, or sigil artifacts.
DEEP-SPEC-PROPOSAL.md and ONE-SHOT-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md are proposals pending operator approval.
External research stays external_context until owner review.
